messages:
Priya: Quick sync — I pushed the first draft of the Reserved Capacity Playbook PRD. Focus areas: SLA targets per tier, throughput sizing for 1/4/1 GPU profiles, autoscale triggers, acceptance tests, and rollback behaviors. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.example/RC-PLAYBOOK. Please skim and drop short notes by EOD Fri. Key open Qs inline.

Alex: Oof, nice start. For 1x GPU reserved profile my gut numbers are: sustained throughput ~1200 tok/s (batched), p95 latency <=250ms for prompt_len<=256. For 1/4-GPU assume ~300 tok/s. I can run perf tests to validate. @Priya, want me to run 3 model sizes (7B/13B/70B) or start with a 13B baseline?

Carlos: Ops note — cold node warmup is ~90s on our infra (image pull + model load + kernel warmups). We can't count on instant scale. We should define a burst buffer policy: allow N bursts before denying (or fallback). Also need a max scale rate (replicas/min) so autoscaler doesn't thrash the cluster.

Mei: Acceptance checklist proposal: 1) Synthetic perf run with p50/p95/p99; 2) Canary on 10% of traffic for 48h with real traffic shapes and customer prompts; 3) Regression tests on prompt suite (1000 prompts) with quality tolerance; 4) Quantized parity checks (outputs within delta); 5) Alerting thresholds and runbook smoke tests. Add error budget calc tied to SLA.

Jamie: Canary rollout steps I'd add to PRD: create canary pool, route 1% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with automated health gates and manual approval at 50%. Include regional ramping (eu/us/apac). Rollback gate: any increase in p99 latency > 20% or error rate > 0.5% for 15m. I'll draft the runbook snippet.

Ben: From contract/pricing POV: reserved SLA should map to credits. Example: 99.9% monthly uptime -> 5% credits, 99.5% -> 10% (draft numbers). Need to decide whether we credit based on time or throughput shortfall. Also need explicit fallback behavior: if capacity constrained, auto-fallback to hosted variant w/ lower priority and notify customer + opt-in agreed. That impacts cost — flagging finance.

Sam: Edge cases to capture in PRD: model mismatch (customer pins model not compatible with quantized pooled variant), KV-cache cold-start causing high mem, extremely long sessions that blow up tokens, and massive fan-out from eval/test jobs. Recommend adding config knobs: `max_tokens_per_session`, `burst_allowance_tokens`, and `session_eviction_threshold`.

Carlos: Also callout: autoscale + cache interactions. When we scale down we must ensure KV cache persistence or accept cold penalty. For on-prem/private customers without shared cache, behavior differs — PRD should list differences.

Priya: Good — adding those. One actionable open: we need concrete numbers for autoscale triggers and the burst buffer policy. Alex/Carlos, can you pair on perf vs warmup numbers?

Alex: Yep. Will run perf matrix Mon/Tue. I'll produce a short CSV with per-model/per-replica tok/s and p95 numbers.

Carlos: I'll draft burst buffer proposal and max scale rate. Thinking: `max_scale_rate = 5 replicas / min` and `burst_allowance = 3 concurrent bursts for up to 60s` as starters.

Mei: For acceptance tests, do we want a defined prompt set per customer segment? e.g., internal (safety + perf) vs enterprise (customer-specific). I can owner the prompt suite for regression.

Jamie: I'll author the canary steps + rollback conditions and link them into the PRD. Also add monitoring queries we'll need in dashboards.

Ben: I'll run a quick SLA credit calc proposal and share a sample clause for contracts.

Sam: I'll write the edge-case appendix and include short mitigations for each (e.g., auto-rollback to non-quantized model, session trimming, reject eval traffic via tags).

Riley-bot: deploy-bot: PRD doc updated by Priya at 1745604400.

Priya: Cool — next steps: Alex validate perf numbers by Tue EOD; Carlos produce burst buffer + scale-rate proposal; Jamie + Mei to draft canary + acceptance docs; Ben to propose SLA credit calc; Sam to author edge-case appendix. I'll consolidate and schedule a customer sync next Wed 10am PT. If anyone can't make the EOD commitments, please ping me. Thanks! :thumbsup:

---

Example autoscale config snippet we can copy into the playbook:

```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 10
  scale_window_sec: 60
  scale_up_threshold: 0.75    # fraction of CPU/GPU util to trigger scale-up
  scale_down_threshold: 0.4  # fraction to scale down
  scale_up_rate_replicas_per_min: 5
  warmup_sec: 90
  burst_buffer_tokens: 10000
  burst_allowance_count: 3
```

Please comment inline on the doc rather than rewriting big sections — want to keep one source of truth.
